selection.rule: Qualify each candidate at its own native reference pin; version migration to the product target is a separate required workstream. No candidate passes transfer across revisions.

source_reconstruction.warning: Numbered patches/series is development history and is not the canonical replay path. Follow the digest-bound canonical snapshot and verify application to the exact native reference.

qualification_release.scope: Independent runtime probe of the released binary. Does not validate candidate HEAD, reproducible source build, native differential parity, hardware performance or the 5.4 product target.

upstream_suites.scope: Entire self-contained upstream unittest module, unchanged assertions; suite execution is required and skipped tests do not count as passing.

known_gaps: Published README claims and strict milestone receipts differ; independent evidence is required.
